Whether you're looking for a fun way to lose weight, stay active after 50, improve heart health, or simply lift your mood, this feel-good workout is designed for beginners and all fitness levels. No complicated choreography — just nonstop movement, good vibes, and a great sweat! Total step count today is 3500 with music at 122 bpm.
In this 30-minute Soca workout, you’ll:
Burn fat and calories
Boost your mood and energy
Improve cardio fitness and endurance
Get your daily steps in
Have fun while exercising at home
